reasoning: The throw line changes only its quote style. `expect(() => parseMemo("")).to.throw("memo required")` requires the message to contain that text, so the StringLiteral mutant fails. ripr reports `weakly_exposed` with the related test as broad_error/weak, under-crediting a discriminating chai message check.
